resources.string: Settings for configuring Qualcomm® aptX™ audio codec
Select keybox XML used for key attestation spoofing for all apps system wide. Click the delete button in order to reset the keybox data values used by the system.

Select PIF JSON used for prop attestation spoofing for google mobile services and play store. Click the delete button in order to reset the PIF data props and use dynamic PIF props which are used by default.
Remove screenshot / screenrecord limits for all applications
Hide screen capture and screen record status from all applications. Can be convenient in some cases but may lead to privacy leaks.
